description: Repairs r-ado-1b/batch-scope-group: both adAffectGroup attempts failed while a row 3 edit was pending and with a string Filter, so the two causes were not separated. This probe has neither: no edit is pending and the Filter is a constant. On a client static batch-optimistic recordset of SELECT ID, Code, V, V2, S FROM W ORDER BY ID (read-write copy of r-ado-1b-main): S of rows 1, 2 and 3 set to "g1", "g2", "g3", each posted with Update (EditMode read), Errors read and cleared; Filter = adFilterPendingRecords (Filter, RecordCount); UpdateBatch(adAffectGroup) with Errors read and cleared right after; the stored rows through Execute; Filter none and every row's Status and S; Filter = adFilterPendingRecords again (RecordCount) and UpdateBatch(adAffectGroup) on that remaining group, Errors; Filter = adFilterAffectedRecords (RecordCount). Asks which rows the group submits and how an empty group answers.
retentionNote: Designed r-fix-wire-ado probe (A-02); complete capture of the ACE answer.
